name: lyrics_sync
description: Sync lyrics text to audio using Whisper word timestamps on clean vocals (output of stem_separation). The song is transcribed in windows of up to 30 s, cut at quiet points, and the lyrics are aligned to Whisper's words in order, which also detects the lyrics window; unmatched words are interpolated between matched ones. Outputs a caption track JSON grouped by lyric phrase, ready to use as project.json captions or as overlay entries via lyric-phrase.jsx. For best results, pass the vocals stem from stem_separation rather than the full mix.

input.description: Vocals WAV from stem_separation (--stems vocals), or any audio/video file

output.description: Caption track JSON: { segments: [{ text, start, end, words: [{word, start, end}] }], audioInPoint: number }

params.name: lyrics
params.description: Path to lyrics text file. One phrase per line. Blank lines ignored.

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model. Defaults to large-v3-turbo-q5_0; a model that is not installed falls back to one that is.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code passed to Whisper (default: en)

params.name: start
params.description: Optional: override start time in seconds (skips auto-detection). Use when auto-detection is off.

params.name: end
params.description: Optional: override end time in seconds (skips auto-detection).
